claims.content: To enable an end-user customer to browse and search the site through category “Browse” pages / search result pages and search and navigation capability.

goal.raw_text: To enable an end-user customer to browse and search the site through category “Browse” pages / search result pages and search and navigation capability.

claims.content: Customer
The platform solution has Endeca or Endeca-like search and navigation capability integrated, with significant drill-down capability due to the large number of SKUs.

All active auction items are searchable by all item attributes, including product ID, auction number, product category, product type, stone type, metal type, current price, as well as full text search on the description field.
The Customer initiates browsing and searching the site via the category “Browse” pages / search result pages.

trigger.raw_text: The Customer initiates browsing and searching the site via the category “Browse” pages / search result pages.

claims.content: Customer navigates from the Home Page to Catalog Pages.
The interaction occurs on the category “Browse” pages / search result pages.
The system displays the global site header & footer.
The system displays a navigational bread crumb trail at the top of the page.
The system displays the Endeca navigation section on the left side of the page in an expanded state.
Drill-down capabilities are available in the navigation section.
The system displays breadcrumbs on category pages similar to Home > Browse/search criteria 1 > Additional criteria > Additional criteria.
The system uses multiple page templates depending on the user’s initial click action (gemstones, jewelry, watches, jeweler supplies, and collectibles).

From main flow step 1, the Customer may navigate from the category “Browse” pages / search result pages to Product Details (Bidding); Catalog Pages connect bidirectionally to Product Details (Bidding).
From main flow step 7, the system uses multiple page templates depending on the user’s initial click action: gemstones, jewelry, watches, jeweler supplies, and collectibles.
If an item is closed, it is removed within 1 minute (or whatever interval).
Closed Items: items that are closed will be removed within 1 minute (or whatever interval); exit: the closed item is removed from the category “Browse” pages / search result pages.
If the search results in multiple items found, a category / search result page should load, using the default catalog view page.
If there is only one search match, the product details page should load.
No Results Found: The No Results page should include a “Popular Searches” links section.
No product will ever be eligible to appear on a product details page, search results, or catalog page if it does not have an available image to display.
Breadcrumbs will appear on the category pages and the product details pages.
The Endeca navigation section will appear on the left side of the page; on these pages, Endeca will appear in an expanded state.
Closed Items: Items that are closed will be removed within 1 minute (or whatever interval).
Global site header & footer are displayed.
